jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY

**Are you a newly graduated legal professional or do you have a few years of experience and want to develop your career in a dynamic business? We are looking for a Junior Legal Counsel to join our Legal Team and support the business across key areas such as GDPR, marketing law and consumer law.

You will work closely with colleagues across the organisation, providing legal guidance and finding practical solutions that balance legal requirements with commercial priorities. This is an opportunity to build your legal expertise while gaining an understanding of how legal considerations translate into business decisions.

We are a small, collaborative team where everyone contributes, takes responsibility and gets involved. We value curiosity, initiative and a solution-oriented mindset, giving you room to grow and make an impact.

**What You Will Do

**In this role, you will support different departments across Boozt with a range of legal matters. Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Advise and Support: Provide legal guidance to colleagues across the business, primarily within GDPR, marketing law and consumer law.

• 
Assess and Navigate: Identify legal risks and help the business find practical solutions, balancing legal requirements with commercial needs.

• 
Stay Informed: Keep up to date with relevant laws and regulations to support compliance and minimise risk.

• 
Dispute Resolution: Support the handling and resolution of legal disputes.

**YOUR PROFILE

**You are a curious and pragmatic legal professional who enjoys understanding both the details of a legal matter and the wider business context. You are comfortable taking responsibility, working collaboratively and finding solutions when faced with new challenges.

**About

**You understand that good legal advice is not only about identifying risks, but also about helping the business move forward in a responsible and commercially sound way. We imagine that you have:

• 
A Master's degree in Law from a recognised university.

• 
Recently graduated or have a couple of years of relevant experience, preferably from a law firm or an in-house legal function.

• 
An interest in GDPR, marketing law and consumer law.

• 
Ideally, some exposure to retail, e-commerce or other consumer-facing businesses.

• 
Strong analytical skills and an eye for detail, combined with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

• 
The ability to communicate legal matters clearly and collaborate with different stakeholders.

• 
Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language.

Last but not least, you are a team player who takes initiative, gets involved and approaches challenges with a "there is always a solution" mindset. You do not need to know everything from day one - curiosity, sound judgement and a willingness to learn matter most.

**WHY BOOZT

**At Boozt, you will become part of an organisation where things move fast and new challenges are part of everyday life. You will join a collaborative team where your input matters, and where you will have the opportunity to grow your legal expertise while gaining insight into different parts of the business.

We believe in Trust, Freedom and Responsibility, and give our colleagues the space to take initiative, make decisions and make their mark. At Boozt, you will be encouraged to ask questions, challenge perspectives and find solutions together.

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

**_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• 
Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• 
A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• 
Driven and passionate international colleagues

• 
A generous employee discount

• 
Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• 
In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• 
An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

Ready to bridge innovation and operations in one of the Nordics' most recognized media brands?

Egmont IT is looking for a new Platform Engineer profile who thrives on improving and automating our cloud environments, while understanding the importance of stability, governance, and performance.

You’ll join Egmont’s Cloud Platform team, working primarily with Azure, AWS. Egmont’s cloud footprint is very large and requires that everyone thinks about automation and scalability first.

**Your Role & Impact

**We are looking for a colleague that is great at asking questions and challenging decisions. We already have a solid Kubernetes based platform used across the Enterprise. Now we need someone to come and help expand it, help our colleagues using and help in the other areas of Egmonts platform engineering

You will be doing hands-on work on our cloud platforms and solutions to ensure that we constantly improve on new solutions. As well  as evaluating old implementations to determine when it is time to modernize.

Responsibilities

- Operate, develop and build on our Kubernetes platform

- Automating daily work around the cloud platforms we manage

- Develop and maintain tooling (GitHub Actions, Helm, Policies, etc)

- Strengthen observability and proactive monitoring – We use Datadog

- Use Infrastructure as Code to manage changes and enforce standards

- Collaborate with developers, security, and infrastructure teams and business stakeholders to ensure stability and compliance

• Contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and help evolve our culture

**What You’ll Bring (Qualifications)

**We're looking for a blend of technical expertise and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

**Desired Skills

**- Experience from previous platform engineering or DevOps roles

- Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (Either is fine)

- Scripting or programming skills in any popular language, we use Go

- Experience with IaC tools, any apply, but we use Terraform

- Experience using ArgoCD

- Experience in agentic tooling and a curiosity in following latest trends

- Previously worked with open source and CNCF projects

Personal Qualities

You can build, automate, and optimize, but you also know that reliability, performance, and security are the foundation of success. You’re curious, pragmatic, and want to be part of a team that’s building a hosting platform, which is easy to use for our developers.

**Why Egmont?

**At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. Flexible hybrid work setup (Copenhagen HQ + home office). A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Ready to join?

**Logistics & How to Apply

**Location: Vognmagergade 11, 1148 Copenhagen K, Denmark

Application deadline: December 18 , 2026

Interviews: Will be scheduled periodically.

Please send your application as soon as possible - we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English. To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact Rasmus Jørgensen (Manager, Cloud Platforms) at rasmusbo.jorgensen@egmont.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

- for the developer who wants to build real things with AI

You write clean code, you have started integrating LLMs into real projects, and you are curious about what comes next. In Egmont's Data & AI Solutions team, you will build practical AI solutions - APIs, LLM wrappers, MCP connectors - that business teams across the Nordics depend on, while sharing ownership of the production systems that keep everything running. Hands-on from day one, with room to grow.

The role

You will be joining a team that builds and maintains AI and data solutions for business units across the Egmont Group - tools and integrations that people actually use.

Your work will cover three areas:

Build applied AI solutions. On top of Egmont’s AI platform infrastructure, you will build LLM wrappers, APIs, and MCP connectors - and take prototypes from concept to working solutions for business units with AI-related challenges.

Support Egmont's companies. You will work directly with companies across the Egmont Group, as both a hands-on builder and an advisor. That means helping business teams see where AI can make a real difference, shaping the right approach with them, and staying involved until it works in practice.

Keep things running - and make them better. You will share ownership of our Prefect-orchestrated Python pipelines alongside our senior engineers, handling operational triage, debugging, and continuous stability improvements.

What you bring

We care more about what you have built and how you think than about your job titles. That said, to hit the ground running, you will bring at least two years of experience in software development or a similar field, along with most of the following:

- Solid Python development experience - clean, modular code and confidence building and consuming APIs, including authentication, JSON and error handling

- Practical LLM integration experience - you have worked with language models in real settings and know your way around context engineering, MCP and agentic integrations

- An analytical and operational mindset - you keep the bigger picture in view, spot problems before they become incidents and take pride in systems that stay stable

Bonus points for experience with orchestration tools, lightweight frontends or Azure and AWS basics.

Beyond the technical, we are looking for someone curious and clear in their communication, who enjoys making technology accessible to non-technical colleagues. Knowledge of a Scandinavian language is an advantage, as Egmont is primarily a Nordic media group.

The team

You will be joining Data & AI Solutions - a tight-knit team of developers. We work closely with the platform team that runs the data and AI infrastructure our solutions are built on, so you will always have strong technical peers to spar with.

The role is based at Egmont's corporate office in Copenhagen. A flexible hybrid setup is possible, and we can agree on the balance between office and home days together.

And yes - the canteen is excellent.

**Logistics & How to Apply

**- Location: Copenhagen (hybrid possible)

- Application deadline: December 6, 2026

- Employment type: Full-time, permanent

To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Note that we do not accept applications via email. Applications are welcome in Danish, Norwegian, Swedish or English.

We review applications continuously, so please apply as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to reach out to Hampus Vitestam, Manager Data & AI Solutions at hampus.vitestam@egmont.com.

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join the Danfoss Technology Centre, a team of materials and process specialists supporting Danfoss businesses worldwide.

From our advanced laboratories in Nordborg, Denmark, we provide expert advice, testing, analysis, and consultancy. We help solve complex technical challenges, support product development, and improve product and process performance.

As our new Senior Specialist, you will provide advanced materials science expertise, primarily within metals and other inorganic materials. You will lead complex materials and failure investigations, turn analytical results into clear conclusions, and advise colleagues and stakeholders on practical solutions.

Your expertise will help teams across Danfoss make well-informed technical decisions and develop reliable, high-performing products and processes.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead complex materials and failure investigations, including fracture, contamination, and microstructural analysis.

• Analyze metals and other inorganic materials using scanning electron microscopy and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM/EDX).

• Turn scientific findings into clear conclusions, reports, presentations, and practical recommendations.

• Coordinate customer assignments involving many stakeholders, samples, and analytical methods.

• Improve analytical methods, assure quality, and share knowledge with specialists and laboratory technicians.

You will also use scientific literature to support investigations and keep our materials knowledge and methods up to date.

**What We're Looking For

**To succeed in this role, you bring:

• Strong materials characterization expertise, including hands-on SEM/EDX and failure analysis experience.

• A PhD in materials science, metallurgy, or a related field is preferred.

• The ability to independently lead complex technical investigations from problem definition to recommendation.

• Strong scientific problem-solving skills and a practical approach to laboratory work.

• Clear English communication skills and the ability to communicate and engage stakeholders at all levels.

Experience from an industrial environment or technical consultancy is highly desirable. You are also curious, collaborative, and able to turn scientific knowledge into practical engineering solutions.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• Work with advanced laboratories and varied technical challenges across Danfoss.

• Collaborate with specialists, technicians, and product developers worldwide.

• Help engineer a better future through solutions that make a global difference.

• Grow through mentoring, learning opportunities, and global career paths.

• Enjoy flexibility, autonomy, and support for a healthy work-life balance.

• Join an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and empowered.

• Receive competitive benefits, including bonus, vacation, pension, and health insurance. Benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you are motivated by solving complex materials challenges and using your expertise to create practical value, we would like to hear from you.

Please apply through our online recruitment system. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every preferred qualification. Your experience may bring perspectives and strengths that will add value to our team.

**For Further Information About The Position, Please Contact

**Dorthe Berg Buciek, Senior Manager,

Email: **buciek@danfoss.com

**Phone: **+45 29 48 70 19

****Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Job Description

**_Transaction Banking is changing fast, and the way customers connect with their bank is becoming more sophisticated. Danske Bank is bringing its Customer Implementation and Integration areas together under one unit, and we are looking for a leader who can create a shared direction, build a strong leadership team, and make complex customer journeys simpler and more consistent across five markets.

_**What You Will Be Doing

**You will lead a newly unified organisation spanning Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Lithuania, bringing together experienced leaders, specialist teams and distinct capabilities. Reporting directly to the Head of TxB Sales Enablement, you will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Product, Technology, IT and Tribe organisations to shape end-to-end customer experiences. Your role sits at the intersection of business, operations and technology, and the decisions you make will shape how corporate customers and financial institutions connect with Danske Bank.

More specifically, you will:

• Set the strategic direction and priorities across all five markets

• Build and develop a leadership team grounded in clarity, empowerment and accountability

• Connect Customer Implementation and Integration to create more seamless customer journeys

• Partner with IT and Tribe teams to shape customer-facing solutions and internal tooling

• Use client insights to inform implementation journeys, integration solutions and commercial priorities

• Encourage the responsible adoption of AI to simplify processes and build employee capabilities

**About You

**

• Solid experience leading organisations through other leaders

• Genuine commitment to developing people, teams and leadership cultures

• Ability to create direction across countries or complex organisational structures

• Skilled at translating strategy into clear priorities and tangible outcomes

• Strong customer and commercial orientation

• Comfortable at the intersection of business, operations and technology

• Able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations

You do not need to come from a traditional banking background. Experience from financial services, consulting, technology, transformation, customer implementation, integrations, APIs, cash management or similar environments is equally relevant and welcome.

**What We Offer You

**This is a rare opportunity to shape a newly formed organisation and leave a lasting mark on how Danske Bank delivers for its customers. You will work in a hybrid model, typically three to four days per week in the office, alongside talented colleagues across multiple markets. We invest in our leaders and offer genuine scope to grow, both in the role and across the wider organisation.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right move for you, we encourage you to apply. You are also welcome to reach out to Natasha Rajovic, Head of TxB Sales Enablement, at nkuz@danskebank.dk with any questions before applying.

Location: Aarhus or Copenhagen.

**We look forward to hearing from you!

****About Us

**Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.

Want to be a part of a fantastic adventure?

Villa Copenhagen is a social scene in Copenhagen allowing the past, present and future to come together in an inspiring, playful and authentic ambiance.

We live by our values - Contrast - Playful - Local. These values form our daily lives at Villa Copenhagen as well as guide us towards our vision of being the best hotel FOR the world.

We are now looking for an Inhouse Sales Agent

Skills & qualifications needed

• 
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a similar role or industry

• 
You either speak one of the Scandinavian languages or English

• 
Highly organised with strong written and verbal communication skills

• 
Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills

• 
Hospitality mindset

• 
Collaborative team player with a strong can do attitude

You identify with the following

You thrive in a high pressure and dynamic environment ensuring a consistently high level of productivity and operational standards paying particular attention to details. You are a true team player, approachable and have a can-do attitude. You are a Cosmopolitan spirit with a genuine love for Copenhagen and Mother Earth.

Responsibilities

• 
Respond to incoming inquiries from clients and timely follow up

• 
Be creative in your sales approach by customizing proposals

• 
Constructing, negotiating and closing of contracts

• 
Responsible for own proposals by actively working with Pipeline Management

• 
Conduct site inspections with the aim of closing business opportunities

• 
Creating strong relations with clients for future and repeat business

• 
Strong collaboration with the F&B Team, Event Team, Planning Team and the Proactive Sales Team

What we can offer (amongst other things)

• 
Pension program with health insurance

• 
4 free hotel night stays per year within the Strawberry chain (contract higher than 20%)

• 
25% discount on food & beverages at all our restaurants & bars

• 
Staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 200+ hotels

• 
Sweet deals on experiences, travels, retail and lots more!

• 
The opportunity to grow and develop in an inspiring environment

• 
Together with a team of dedicated and passionate people, you have the chance to put your very personal imprint and create a Villa Copenhagen that you - and we - are proud to be part of. A preferred place to work. We come from very different backgrounds and we love how that diversity positively influences our work

Are we the perfect match?

The position is a full-time position, reporting to the Director of Sales

If you see yourself in the description above, we’d love to hear from you! Please upload your CV and answer a few quick screening questions by 27th of November to let us know who you are. We look forward to reviewing your application.

For questions, please contact the Director at Sales at tina.hansen@nordichotels.com (no applications)

Interviews will be held throughout the application period.

We hire attitude ….and train skills

jobs.description:
Looking for an Ambitious part time Job?

Aalund are market leaders when it comes to B2B research and that is why we are looking for ambitious B2B researchers. The task is to conduct telephone interviews with Finnish business managers and other decisionmakers.

As a B2B researcher at Aalund, it is your task to make sure that our respondents are given a unique experience. New projects are continuously added to our pipeline to the benefit of your professional development. We offer one of the most attractive salary arrangements in the business as well as an ambitious environment with an informal work culture. At Aalund, professionalism, experience and humour are part of our culture. We offer a 5-10 hour work week, depending on your wishes, and working hours are weekdays between 8.30 AM and 5 PM although on Fridays we finish at 2:30 PM.

 

On top of that, we offer: 

·        Training in communication and interview technique while we also teach you our interviewing philosophy

·        Project briefings and a close interaction with our supervisors and consultants

·        Relevant experience that you can use onwards in your career

·        A dynamic team which includes full time and part time employees

·        A job that will look good on your resume

·        Salary: 140/hour once you have passed our basic course

·        Social events every quarter

 

Does that sound attractive to you? Send an application which includes your resume to our job portal https://job.aalund.com/ and you will soon hear from us. Dont hesitate to Call Department Manager Marie Salicath, phone: +4587310900 in case you have any questions.

**Job Requisition ID #

**26WD102106

**Locations where we are Hiring

**This is not a current open position. Soon, we will be investing in remote Regional Field Sales roles across the EMEA region specific to Europe: Ireland, Denmark, Sweden, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Netherlands, and Spain.

**Our Story

**The world’s innovators, designers, engineers, builders and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make a better world for all.

Autodesk’s Design and Make Platform empowers customers to transform how they work through cloud-connected technology, automation, AI, data and insights. From the buildings and infrastructure around us to the products we use and the entertainment that inspires us, Autodesk technology helps our customers design and make the world around us.

Our customers are navigating significant change, including sustainability pressures, labor and supply-chain challenges, rapid technological advancement and increasing digital complexity. Global Expansion Sales helps them unlock greater value from Autodesk by uncovering new opportunities, expanding adoption and connecting Autodesk solutions to their most important business priorities.

**Position Overview

****As an Account Executive in Global Expansion Sales, you will lead Autodesk’s growth strategy across a focused portfolio of assigned customers.

**You will operate as a senior business partner to the customer, bringing a hunter mindset to existing relationships: creating new demand, uncovering substantial whitespace, opening new buying centers and expanding Autodesk into strategic workflows, business units and transformation initiatives.

You will be expected to lead complex, high-value enterprise sales cycles, including seven-figure opportunities and multi-year commercial agreements, while orchestrating the broader Autodesk ecosystem around a common customer strategy. Success will be measured through sustained expansion growth, material pipeline creation, increased share of wallet, executive sponsorship, customer outcomes and forecast accuracy.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own and lead the multi-year growth and expansion strategy for assigned customers.

• Develop deep knowledge of each customer’s business model, strategic objectives, operating environment, industry dynamics and transformation agenda.

• Establish a clear point of view on where Autodesk can create differentiated business value for the customer.

• Identify significant whitespace across business units, geographies, workflows, technology estates, user communities and executive priorities.

• Create demand and originate large strategic opportunities, including seven-figure deals and opportunities that may not yet exist in the customer’s formal buying process.

• Build relationships across new buying centers while deepening trusted relationships with existing stakeholders.

• Develop C-suite and senior executive sponsorship across business and technology functions.

• Bring external market, industry and customer insight into executive conversations, with relevant knowledge of Autodesk’s Design and Make industries.

• Translate customer strategy into compelling multi-year value propositions, transformation roadmaps and business cases.

• Lead complex, high-value and potentially multi-year sales cycles involving multiple business, technical, procurement, finance and legal stakeholders.

• Develop and execute competitive strategies to win strategically significant new workloads and displace incumbent technologies.

• Navigate sophisticated commercial arrangements and seven-figure negotiations with strong business and financial acumen.

• Mobilize Autodesk’s executive leadership and broader organization around a unified account strategy.

• Orchestrate Technical Sales, Customer Success, Industry, Partners, Marketing, Professional Services and other specialists at the appropriate stages of the customer journey.

• Develop strategic ecosystem and partner relationships that increase Autodesk’s impact and relevance.

• Maintain executive-level governance around opportunities, risks, dependencies and account priorities.

• Apply account-planning, relationship-mapping, customer intelligence, forecasting and AI-enabled tools responsibly to support multi-year account strategy, executive engagement and opportunity governance.

• Maintain rigorous pipeline quality and deliver accurate, evidence-based forecasts.

• Represent the voice of the customer within Autodesk while bringing relevant Autodesk innovation, capability and thought leadership back to the customer.

**What Success Looks Like

**Sustained strategic revenue growth; creation and conversion of substantial new whitespace; increased Autodesk share of wallet; expansion into strategically important workloads and business initiatives; deep C-suite sponsorship; successful execution of seven-figure opportunities; strong multi-year account strategies; competitive displacement; measurable customer outcomes; and consistently high-quality forecasting.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Demonstrated success leading complex enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud or strategic software sales.

• Proven record of creating and closing significant opportunities within large, complex customer organizations, including experience with seven-figure deals or comparable commercial complexity.

• Demonstrated ability to create demand and develop major opportunities rather than simply manage an existing pipeline.[KS1]

• Strong C-suite presence with the ability to engage credibly on business, industry and transformation priorities.

• Exceptional strategic account-planning and whitespace-development capability.

• Strong business and financial acumen and ability to build compelling economic and strategic business cases.

• Experience leading sophisticated multi-stakeholder and multi-year sales processes.

• Strong competitive selling, negotiation and commercial leadership capability.

• Demonstrated ability to lead large virtual teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

• Exceptional communication, storytelling and executive presentation skills.

• High standards of commercial judgment, accountability, pipeline management and forecasting.

• Demonstrated fluency with CRM, strategic account-planning, relationship-mapping, pipeline and forecasting platforms. Experience with Salesforce, Clari, Altify or comparable platforms is valued.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Deep knowledge of a relevant Autodesk Solution Group industry - AEC, Manufacturing or Media & Entertainment - where appropriate to the assigned customer portfolio.

• Experience selling enterprise platforms, cloud technology or large-scale transformation solutions.

• Experience navigating complex multinational customer organizations.

• Demonstrated success developing multi-year executive relationships and transformation programs.

• Track record of strategic competitive displacement and significant share-of-wallet growth.

**How We Work At Autodesk

**At Autodesk, we work as One Autodesk and bring our One ORBIT values to life every day: Optimistic, Relentless, Brave, Ingenious and Trusted.

A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Student Assistant in HR Services at Siemens Energy, you will be based at our office in Aalborg while working closely with our HR Services team, which is located across multiple sites in Denmark. The team play a key role in supporting our blue-collar colleagues and managers, as well as coordinating with external HR service providers. Much of their daily work involves control tasks, data checks and follow-ups related to payroll, time management and other HR processes.

Your role will involve finding ways to simplify these tasks, improve efficiency and reduce manual work. You will explore how tasks are currently carried out and develop tools to reduce manual work, including well-structured Excel files, Power BI reports that provide a clear overview, and practical applications of AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot. Expect a hands-on role in a collaborative team where your ideas are valued and put into practice.

We are looking for a bachelor's student who would like to stay with us for several years while continuing with a master's degree. This will give you the opportunity to develop your skills and gradually take on more responsibility as you grow into the role.

How You'll Make an Impact

Map recurring control and follow-up tasks in HR Services and identify opportunities to simplify, standardised or automate them.

• 
Explore opportunities to use AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, and work on Power Automate flows to reduce manual work and improve quality.

Lead Designer for the world’s most impactful CPR training programs

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Designer who loves great Interaction Design, UX & UI craft, and can also set direction and bring an organisation with them.

At Laerdal, we develop CPR training solutions used by healthcare professionals and organisations around the world, with a mission to help save one million more lives each year by 2030.

We are seeking an exceptional Lead Designer to join our cross-functional product team in Copenhagen, working on the psycho-motor skills experience of RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete. These are cornerstone programs in the collaboration between Laerdal Medical and the American Heart Association, reaching millions of healthcare professionals across the globe.

This is an opportunity to shape experiences that ultimately help people become better prepared to save a life.

The design challenge goes well beyond screens. Learners move between digital instruction, software-guided practice, physical interaction with manikins and training stations, assessment, and certification. Your role is to make that entire experience coherent, intuitive, and effective.

About us

In Laerdal Copenhagen we are around 150 people developing best-in-class digital learning products. We hire people with grit and mission-driven hearts, and by joining us, you will become part of a unique and dynamic workplace that appreciates diversity, authenticity, ambition, and long-term, sustainable solutions.

We are a unique mix of talents, from medical doctors and learning specialists to designers, software engineers and 3D engineers, working with international partners to deliver effective learning solutions.

Some of what we offer

• A collaborative and diverse environment with lots of passion and energy. Our workplace is friendly and casual, located in an old warehouse at Islands Brygge.

• An outstanding teamwork culture driven by the mission of helping save lives.

• Fair compensation.

• Great opportunities for growth and personal development in a global organization

About you

You are an exceptional hands-on product designer who cares deeply about craft. You are equally comfortable defining an end-to-end learner experience, working through a complex interaction, and crafting the final UI that gets built.

You enjoy getting close to users, turning insight into ideas, and making those ideas tangible through flows, prototypes and high-quality screen designs. You have a strong eye for visual and interaction design, and you care about the details that make a product feel intuitive, coherent and polished.

At Lead level, we also expect you to look beyond the individual screen or feature. You can articulate a compelling design direction, bring Product, Engineering and other stakeholders with you, and use prototypes and customer evidence to move the team from discussion to experimentation and implementation faster.

This is a hands-on design role. You will be the designer creating the UX and UI for these products, not someone handing the work over to another designer.

About the role

On this cross-functional team, you will:

• Own the UX and UI design craft for RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete.

• Design the learner experience across digital interfaces, software-guided training and physical interaction with manikins and training stations.

• Create user flows, interaction models, wireframes, prototypes and polished, implementation-ready UI designs using Laerdal’s Life Design System.

• Work closely with Engineering throughout implementation, reviewing the built experience and ensuring that design quality and intent survive through release.

• Prototype early and often, putting tangible ideas in front of learners and customers rather than relying on presentations and specifications.

• Lead discovery and collaborate with a Design Researcher on research and usability testing to understand learner needs and validate solutions.

• Build a deep understanding of healthcare professionals and their CPR learning and certification journeys through direct engagement with learners, instructors and customers.

• Shape and communicate a strong design vision for the products, creating alignment across Product, Engineering, Educational Specialists and other stakeholders.

• Help the team shorten the cycle from idea to prototype, customer test, learning and release.

• Use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping and iteration.

• Travel to the US and other markets to observe training, test solutions and work directly with customers and partners.

Qualifications

• A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent hands-on UX, interaction and UI design craft in shipped products.

• Strong visual design skills and attention to detail, with the ability to take work all the way from rough concept to production-ready interface.

• Excellent prototyping skills, from quick experiments to realistic prototypes suitable for customer testing.

• Deep understanding of user-centered design, with demonstrated experience involving users throughout the design process.

• Experience designing complex digital products where software is part of a broader physical experience is a strong advantage.

• Ability to establish a product or experience design vision and translate it into concrete design work.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders through customer evidence and tangible design proposals.

• An AI-first mindset toward your own design toolchain and cross-functional workflows in the team.

• Experience with healthcare, medical technology, learning products or connected devices is an advantage.

• Willingness to travel internationally, particularly to the US.

If you're passionate about design and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to join our team at Laerdal Medical in Copenhagen. We’re looking forward to receiving your:

• Letter of motivation,

• CV, and

• Portfolio (can be a link to an online resource)

Only applications with all three will be reviewed. Beware that LinkedIn only allows one document upload, so merge them into one, before you hit the APPLY button.

Start date: ASAP.

GET A FEELING…

…of who we are in Laerdal Copenhagen in this video:

https://vimeo.com/917084721/73a5d9e58a

…and see more about our mission goal:

https://one-million-lives.com/a-shared-goal/

As an Imaging Engineer, you will contribute to the development and integration of imaging solutions for endoscope products. You will work with camera sensors, lenses, illumination and image-quality testing, supported by senior colleagues and cross-functional specialists in the medical device domain. The role combines practical laboratory work, technical problem-solving, supplier collaboration and structured documentation.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Contribute to the development of imaging technology, including sensor, optics and illumination in technology projects to build solid imaging solution roadmap.

• Participate in endoscope product-development projects, focusing on imaging component integration and imaging system performance, which include:

• Participate in user-related event and identify user need for imaging requirements.

• Support the selection and evaluation of sensors, lenses, illumination components and related imaging solutions.

• Assist with integration of imaging solutions into the product in collaboration with mechanical, electronics, quality and NPI engineers.

• Perform hands-on camera testing, image-quality evaluation, troubleshooting and documentation.

• Participate in user testing in clinical settings and provide imaging-related technical support.

• Prepare reports and technical documentation in line with medical-device development processes.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• A relevant degree in Optoelectronics, Electronics, Physics, Computer vision or a related engineering field.

• 2+ years of relevant professional experience. Strong graduates with practical project, internship or laboratory experience are also encouraged to apply.

• Basic understanding of camera systems and components such as image sensors, lenses, illumination and electronic interfaces.

• Familiarity with key imaging and optical performance concepts, for example SNR, dynamic range, noise, MTF, depth of field, field of view and distortion.

• Interest in hands-on testing, measurement, data analysis and systematic problem-solving.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering disciplines.

• A proactive approach to work and strong communication skills.

• A curious, structured and user-focused mindset with motivation to learn.

**Nice to have

**

• Exposure to ISP functions, camera calibration or imaging-pipeline tuning.

• Basic knowledge of mechanics, electronics or embedded camera systems.

• Practical use of laboratory equipment or image-quality measurement methods.

• Experience with Python programming and image/video analysis

**What You Will Gain

**

• Hands-on experience across the full imaging chain, from sensor and optics to illumination and image quality.

• Mentoring and technical guidance from experienced camera and product-development engineers.

• Opportunities to work with top-notch suppliers, prototypes, product teams and clinical users.

• A strong foundation for growing into an imaging specialist and imaging system-level engineering.

BLAST is a global esports media network on a mission to create world-class entertainment experiences for millions of fans around the world. From high-energy arena shows and studio broadcasts to digital content that sets new standards, we bring the biggest moments in esports to life - working with top-tier partners like Valve, Riot Games, Epic Games, Ubisoft, Krafton, and more.

BLAST has grown into a leading force in the esports space, but we're just getting started when it comes to pushing boundaries and shaping the future of the industry.

You'll be part of a diverse and dynamic organisation with roots in traditional sports, entertainment, and esports - all working together to deliver unforgettable experiences and keep raising the bar.

**The team

Our culture is built around getting things done - we value initiative, ownership, and practical solutions over endless processes. At the same time, we believe in growing together: there's plenty of room to learn, challenge yourself, and expand your skillset alongside experienced professionals.

Bonus? This job will take you places - literally. From major cities to remote broadcast sites, we travel the world to make things happen. If you're ready to bring energy, adaptability, and a sense of adventure, you'll fit right in.

**Requirements

**

• Curious, quick learner and eager to master new technologies

• Proactive and decisive with a strong sense of ownership

• Ability to work at our Copenhagen office and Brøndby Studio

• Ability to travel to and work at events globally

• Previous experience in working large broadcast shows on flightpack / OB Truck

• Proficient in the english language

• Experience with broadcast switchers equipment, such as Sony / Grass Valley etc

**Responsibilities

**

• Programming and setting up Grass Valley K-Frame, Sony XVS and Blackmagic ATEM switchers for highly complex shows

• Implementing new technologies, allowing greater automation, through both Companion and Cerebrum

• Set up general broadcast equipment, including EVS, Cuepilot, Cameras, Riedel Intercom, Routers etc

• Train directors and engineers on our various switchers, and keep us up to date on the latest technologies

**Benefits

**

• Competitive salary package

• Enhanced parental leave

• Pension and Health Insurance

• Awesome new office in the centre of Copenhagen and 2400m2 studio facility in Brøndby

• Team building and social events

• Lunch, snacks and sodas

• Company trips (2024 we all went to Barcelona and had a BLAST)

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Technical Advisory is seeking a highly technical and customer-focused Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions to join our new Embedded Engineering (forward-deployed engineering) team.

You will work directly alongside strategic Autodesk customers to discover high-value workflows, model the data those workflows depend on, and build the AI systems for their Design & Make workflows to enable customer’s measurable business outcomes.

You will move fluidly from understanding a customer's workflow and architecture to writing code. You will spend your weeks writing production code to build agents and orchestration, retrieval and graph services, connectors and APIs - inside customer environments, alongside customer engineers. What you ship is concrete: AI agents, MCP servers and tools, domain and semantic models, knowledge-graph extensions, retrieval and context-resolution pipelines, integrations into ERP, PLM, BIM, enterprise data platforms, and eval harnesses to move new capabilities into production.

Unlike traditional project delivery, Embedded Engineering works deeply inside customer environments, connecting Autodesk technology and data with the rest of the enterprise. Insights developed through customer work will be translated into reusable agents, connectors, reference architectures, engineering patterns, and direct product feedback that shapes Autodesk's platform roadmap.

The successful candidate combines strong software and AI engineering skills with curiosity, customer empathy, business judgment, and the ability to operate independently when the problem is not yet well defined. This role is engagement-driven with travel up to 75% during active engagements, including extended periods working onsite with customers.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.

**Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed below.

**Responsibilities

****Discover Workflows and Own the Outcome

**

• Partner with customer executives, business leaders, and technical teams to translate transformation objectives, operational KPIs, sustainability commitments, and digital initiatives into measurable, AI-enabled workflow outcomes.

• Lead co-innovation with customers to find high-value workflows, decision bottlenecks, data requirements, and integration opportunities, turning ambiguous business challenges into clear technical directions.

• Analyze end-to-end workflows across Autodesk and non-Autodesk systems to pinpoint friction, process inefficiency, data gaps, and the places where AI and agents genuinely change the economics.

• Own technical execution end-to-end - rapid prototype through architecture, build, integration, testing, governance, production deployment guidance, and adoption - with accountability for customer impact.

• Sequence the work and decide what not to build. Make explicit trade-offs between scope, speed, and durability, and defend them to both customer and Autodesk stakeholder

**Make Data and Context AI-Ready

**

• Assess customer data readiness - fragmented sources, ownership, quality, lineage, metadata, governance, permissioning, and integration constraints - required to support trusted AI and agentic workflows.

• Structure and connect design intent, project, product, and asset data, along with requirements, supporting evidence, approvals, decisions, and dependencies, into trusted AI-ready data and context models that enable reasoning, retrieval, and agentic action.

• Design ontologies, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs that business users recognize and agents can act on, including entity resolution across source systems, schema mapping, and permission models that survive contact with enterprise reality.

**Build and Ship Production AI

**

• Design and build production-grade AI-enabled workflows, agents, applications, and integrations that connect Autodesk products and platform capabilities with customers' broader enterprise technology environments.

• Build the retrieval and context layer these systems depend on - hybrid search, graph-grounded retrieval, tool interfaces, and MCP servers that expose governed enterprise context to agents safely.

• Make quality measurable. Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, guardrails, tracing, and observability so that agent behavior is testable before launch and monitored after it, and so that quality regressions and drift are caught in production rather than reported by users.

• Apply strong engineering practices across architecture, code quality, security, permissions, reliability, observability, testing, performance, and maintainability, adapting quickly to complex and constrained customer environments.

• Define the operating model for what you build - runbooks, ownership, escalation, and cost - and hand it over cleanly to customer teams or Autodesk services so value persists after the engagement ends.

**Feed the Product and Build Reusable IP

**

• Act as a frontline product discovery mechanism, translating customer learning into prioritized product requirements, platform capability gaps, roadmap recommendations, and opportunities for feature or API acceleration.

• Convert customer-specific learning into reusable Autodesk value - reference architectures, agent and MCP patterns, connectors, ontology templates, graph models, reusable code, evals, and technical playbooks - that reduces the cost of every engagement that follows.

**Build an AI-Native Practice

**

• Design, build, and operationalize the agents, workflows, and automations that make the Embedded Engineering organization itself faster and more effective, measuring success by both customer impact and scalable internal leverage. Continuously look for manual work to replace with agentic systems and reusable internal tooling.

• Stay at the frontier. Maintain working knowledge of new model capabilities, agent implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks, and bring what's genuinely useful into practice.

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor across the boundary - partnering with customer engineers, architects, and business leaders, and with Autodesk Sales, Customer Success, Technical Advisory, Product, and Platform teams - to unblock delivery and help teams navigate ambiguity, trade-offs, risk, and changing requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• 6+ years building and operating production software, including 2+ in a customer-facing or embedded role (forward-deployed or founding engineer). CS/Engineering degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Full-stack range. Expert Python plus one of TypeScript, Java, or C# - comfortable across backend, data pipelines, integrations, and a lightweight React surface when a workflow needs one.

• Cloud fluency in Azure or AWS: containers, serverless, managed data stores, and identity and networking inside customer-governed environments (e.g., infrastructure as code with Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation), with strong API, distributed-systems, CI/CD, and observability fundamentals.

• Agentic systems in production. You've built and run single- and multi-agent systems - tool schemas, memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - on a modern orchestration framework (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, Bedrock AgentCore, etc), MCP making practical cost and latency trade-offs (e.g., model selection, caching).

• Evaluation as engineering. You build golden datasets and eval harnesses from real customer data, and you measure groundedness, task success, and retrieval quality using standard tooling (e.g., RAGAS, LangSmith, Langfuse).

• Retrieval and data readiness. You've built retrieval systems end-to-end (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking) over a vector store and can assess and fix messy enterprise data - lineage, permissions, entity resolution, schema mapping.

• Knowledge architecture for AI. You model domain semantics into AI-ready context - ontologies, semantic layers, knowledge graphs - and ground agents in it via GraphRAG or equivalent, using at least one graph technology (e.g., Azure Cosmos DB Gremlin, Amazon Neptune, Neo4j, or equivalent) and its query language (e.g. Gremlin, Cypher, SPARQL).

• Ownership under ambiguity. You take greenfield customer problems from framing to production and measured outcomes and can explain a non-deterministic system with equal credibility to an engineer and an executive.

**Work arrangement

**

• You'll work with one customer at a time on focused engagements, for specified duration, on-site at customer locations that may be outside your home country, with travel of up to 75%, subject to any immigration or other requirements (averages likely to be lower across the whole year). You remain an Autodesk employee throughout, and the intention is that Autodesk's policies, benefits, and time off apply on every assignment. Some customers may have their own onboarding, safety, security or other requirements, which will be discussed with you at the time.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Domain fluency in AECO, with the ability to ramp quickly on design-to-construction-to-operations processes.

• Autodesk platform fluency: Autodesk Platform Services (APS), AEC Data Model API, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Common Data Environment (CDE) concepts, Forma, Fusion, Flow, and Autodesk data models.

• Enterprise systems of record integration: ERP, PDM, PLM, BIM, project controls, cost, scheduling, and asset management, plus enterprise data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, Lakehouse, analytics platforms).

• Constrained enterprise deployment: customer VPCs, private, on-prem, or air-gapped environments, data residency and sovereignty requirements, SSO/SCIM, and formal security review processes.

• AI-native builder practice: routine use of AI coding agents, harnesses, and automation to multiply individual and team throughput, including spec-driven development: writing clear specs and executable acceptance criteria for coding agents, keeping changes small and reviewable, and verifying AI-generated code through automated tests and review.

• Production trust and safety: prompt-injection defense, permission-aware retrieval, provenance and audit trails, versioning, staged rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Ships. Has put things into production and can name the metric that moved.

• Treats evaluation as part of the product. Assumes agents will fail and builds evaluation, observability, and guardrails before scaling.

• Is fluent in both worlds. Understands the customer’s business process and the failure modes of non-deterministic systems.

• Thinks in reusable patterns. Instinctively asks, “How does this become an asset for the next ten customers?”

• Moves fast without leaving a mess. Knows when speed matters, when engineering rigor matters, and how to make that trade-off deliberately.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor or Postdoc in Economics and Business Economics
jobs.description:
The Department of Economics and Business Economics at Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University, is seeking ambitious and dedicated scholars to join a dynamic research and teaching environment. The positions offer excellent opportunities to develop an international research profile and contribute to high-quality teaching. We invite applications for one or more positions as assistant professor or postdoc in the field of economics and business economics.

The positions are full-time and different job packages can be offered including fixed-term postdoc and assistant professorships for up to 4 years. The starting date is 1 August 2027 or as soon as possible subject to mutual agreement.

Job description
As an assistant professor or postdoc, you are expected to make a significant contribution to our research and teaching activities and to support the further development of our overall research strategy.

You will teach and supervise students at both Bachelor's and Master's levels and conduct independent as well as collaborative research of the highest international standard. You are also expected to engage actively in the academic life of the department and contribute to the activities of the relevant research section

Your qualifications
You must have been awarded a PhD degree in economics and business economics or have acquired equivalent qualifications.

Who we are
At the Department of Economics and Business Economics, we aim to conduct research and teaching of the highest quality and impact. We believe that a supportive atmosphere and appreciative work environment are fundamental for our work and professional development. The department employs approximately 140 academic staff members and 55 PhD students, and our academic staff is highly international and culturally diverse. We focus on the recruitment of excellent national and international researchers. Our research and degree programmes have a strong international focus. The Department hosts a number of research centers and external funding for research activities has top priority. Read more about the department on our website www.econ.au.dk 

The Department of Economics and Business Economics is one of the six departments at Aarhus BSS, one of the five faculties at Aarhus University. Aarhus BSS unites the business and social science-related research fields and brings them closer together to reflect the close relationship between society and the business community. As part of a Top 100 university, Aarhus BSS has achieved the triple-crown AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS accreditations.

Further information
For further information about the position, please contact Head of Department, Professor Thomas Quistgaard Pedersen, tel.: +45 27467467, e-mail: tqpedersen@econ.au.dk

If you need help uploading your application or have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR supporter Ulla P. Bjørn, e-mail: upb@au.dk.

Place of work
Aarhus University, Universitetsbyen 51, 8000 Aarhus C.

Are you an international applicant?
Aarhus University offers a wide range of services for international academic staff and their accompanying families, including relocation support and career counselling for accompanying partners. Find more information here: Relocation Service at Aarhus University

Learn more about research opportunities at Aarhus University here: Aarhus University research

Aarhus University also offers a career development programme for postdocs and assistant professors. Read more about the programme here: Junior Researchers

Terms of employment
The appointment is made in accordance with the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities as well as the circular on the Collective Agreement for Academics Employed by the State (in Danish). The job content and qualification requirements are described in further detail in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement for academics in the state sector. You will be employed as assistant professor or postdoc at basic salary level 4–8, with supplements in accordance with the protocol on certain terms of employment for academic staff at universities.

Application procedure
When you apply for this position it is mandatory to attach the following:

• Cover letter. You are encouraged to elaborate on your current and future research plans and on how you match the department’s profile, including potential research centers.
• Curriculum Vitae. You are encouraged to declare any periods of leave or career breaks without research activity, including, for example, parental leave, since your research activities are assessed in relation to your actual research time.
• Education (diploma for master's, PhD and possibly higher doctoral degree).
• List of publications, working papers, and work-in-progress (the enclosed papers must be clearly marked on the list of publications).
• Publications. Up to three papers, including both publications and working papers, may be submitted. In the event of co-authors the included papers must be accompanied by a co-author statement concerning your share of the collaborative work with the consent of the co-authors.This template may be used for the purpose
• Teaching portfolio. The specific requirements regarding the documentation can be found here.
Read more about how to apply for an academic post at Aarhus BSS here.

The evaluation process
After the application deadline, an assessment committee is appointed. Please note that the assessment of applicants is based solely on the material received prior to the application deadline. For further information, see Guidelines for Assessment Committee, Aarhus BSS. 

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website. 

Aarhus University
Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment to its 38,000 students (FTEs) and 8,300 employees, and has an annual revenues of EUR 935 million. Learn more at https://international.au.dk//
